programme.title: Satya
programme.desc: Durga's brother is killed in a gang war, turning him into a revenge-seeking man with a mission. Now, his ex-girlfriends cop husband is out to get him. Finally, the two team up to nab the real culprit.

programme.title: Demon
programme.desc: Vignesh Shivan has scary dreams that bother him a lot. However, the strange things in his dreams make him worry and affect his mind.

programme.title: Pyaar Ka Safar
programme.desc: Bharath has lost everything since his childhood including his love. He is supported by his childhood friend Bhargava. Does Bhargava help him or will he end up destroying him completely?

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Laila
programme.desc: As a young boy, Deshraj was sent away for higher studies in order to protect him from a rival family's wrath. But upon his return, he falls in love with a girl who is the daughter of the same enemy.

programme.title: Sweekar Kiya Maine
programme.desc: After Gopika and Kishan get married, she learns that her husband is a widower and has a child. She leaves him but later returns, asking him to accept her son from a previous relationship.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Calling Bell
programme.desc: Karthik and Vyshali, a newly-wed couple, move into a villa and start living together. Soon, Karthik realises that his wife is a ghost and decides to get rid of her.

programme.title: Jagan
programme.desc: Jagan, an artist by profession, befriends two siblings on separate occasions and they both fall in love with him. He is forcibly married to the elder sister by goons, creating troubles in his life.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Pardesi
programme.desc: Myna rescues Ajay, who is bitten by a snake, but he loses his memory. He begins a new life with Myna and her family and the two fall in love, much to her secret lover's outrage.

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Anjali and Dev are in love with each other and plan to marry, but her family gets her married to Ram. Years later, Dev shows up to reunite with Anjali, however, she has fallen in love with Ram.

programme.title: Krantiveer
programme.desc: After being disowned by his family, Pratap, a juvenile gambler, ends up in Mumbai where he gets adopted by Laxminath, a landlord. However, when Laxminath is murdered, Pratap vows to avenge him.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Race
programme.desc: Two stepbrothers own a huge stud farm and a horse racing business. When they learn that they have a common love interest, one of them tries to kill the other and inherit the insurance money.

programme.title: Dildaar
programme.desc: Guru, a carefree lad who is unemployed, falls in love with Priya. However, when he approaches her brother Nanda to ask for her hand in marriage, he rejects him and offers him money to forego his love.

programme.title: Ek Aur Hero The Dashing
programme.desc: After the death of their eldest brother, Babloo and the other three brothers develop hatred towards women. However, things take a turn when Babloo falls in love with Pooja.

programme.title: Super Shastri
programme.desc: Subramanya, son of a Brahmin priest, falls in love with Sowmya, the daughter of a village criminal. To impress her family, Subramanya decides to become a gangster.

programme.title: Pighalta Aasman
programme.desc: Delhi-based businesswoman Arti Singh travels to Kashmir to claim her land from Suraj Arora. Soon after Arti and Suraj fall in love with each other, she learns that her friend Anu too loves him.

programme.title: Khel Khilari Ka
programme.desc: Ajit swears revenge after witnessing his family's murder by three goons. Years later he becomes a wealthy crime lord, but he still thirsts for revenge.

programme.title: Shehzaade
programme.desc: Suraj, a justice-loving man, must face a series of obstacles when he discovers his widowed mother's affair with a former prisoner.

programme.title: Mera Faisla
programme.desc: Raj wishes to marry Rati but faces humiliation from her father due to the stigma associated with his lineage. Soon, he decides to join the police force to restore his family's honour.

programme.title: Yeh Hai Judgement...
programme.desc: Ashraf Ansari, a local resident of Mumbai, is taken into custody as a suspect for the bomb blast that shakes the entire city. He battles with the police and the corrupt system to prove his innocence.

programme.title: James Pondu
programme.desc: James and Pandu are porters and very good friends. They get appointed by the owner and the manager of a chit fund to steal money, but later fall into a trap.

programme.title: Ek Taqatwar The Mighty
programme.desc: Raju, a thug, falls in love with a girl and gives up his corrupt practices. However, he gets framed for a major scam that brings out his dark past, sabotaging his relationship.

programme.title: Jigri Dost
programme.desc: Shobha prepares to marry an advocate named Anand as arranged by her father. However, she secretly follows him one day and is shocked to see him in the arms of another woman.

programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Kab? Kyoon? Aur Kahan?
programme.desc: Asha, a rich man's daughter, is arrested for her uncle's murder. Inspector Anand, who loves her, tries his best to solve the case and save her.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Jung ka Maidan
programme.desc: Ashok and Anand are best friends in spite of being very different. When Ashok accidentally becomes the reason for a misunderstanding in Anand's wedding procedures, he tries to fix it.

programme.title: Papi Gudia
programme.desc: A criminal uses a possessed doll to lure children and kill them. His latest target is Raju, the young brother of a dancer, who soon becomes the main suspect in a series of murders.

programme.title: Arundhati
programme.desc: An idol from a temple in Kshetram is hidden in a forest to protect it from invaders. The Rayulu family tries hard to reinstate it back to the temple in order to complete an old ritual.

programme.title: Hum Hai Champions
programme.desc: Mallika is blackmailed by a dangerous don to fall in love with his rival's son Panda and eventually murder him. However, Panda is already madly in love with her and does not see what is coming.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Anu and Siddhu are in love and Siddhu turns up when Anu's family camps in a tiger sanctuary for a holiday. Unexpectedly, a sandalwood smuggler takes several members as hostages.

programme.title: Majaal
programme.desc: Vijay falls in love with Sadhana and marries her, but on several occasions, he is disrespected by his in-laws. Frustrated, he loses interest in his married life.

programme.title: Geet
programme.desc: After losing her ability to sing, Neha, a famous star, relocates to a small village. While she attempts to get back her voice, she encounters Rajesh, who decides to help her.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Humse Hai Zamana
programme.desc: Ravindra and Gowri, who belong to rival factions, are sworn enemies. After being imprisoned and learning that his brother was killed, Gowri goes after Ravindra's sister, Preeti, as revenge.

programme.title: Sikka
programme.desc: Vijay and Pranlal, two close friends, decide to marry off their kin in a bid to cement their friendship. Soon, Vijay learns about Pranlal's illegal activities and calls off the wedding.

programme.title: Asmaan Se Ooncha
programme.desc: Inspector Malik transfers to Mumbai along with his family and sets out on a mission to catch King, an underworld leader. However, a shocking revelation changes the course of their lives.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Antim Nyay
programme.desc: Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

programme.title: Action Time
programme.desc: Vedha and his daughter Kanaka are on a killing spree. They are being chased by a cop Rama, but they always manage to escape in the nick of time. Can Rama stop the killings?

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Kaise Kahoon Ke...Pyaar Hai
programme.desc: Karan, a burglar, wishes to permanently leave his profession when he falls in love with Priya. They decide to get married, but Karan finds out that he has cancer.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Sultanat
programme.desc: Sultan, a brave warrior, tries to win the affections of Yasmin, a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside-down when his father is killed by a general who he then swears revenge against.

programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: 100 Days of Love
programme.desc: Despite their strained history as children, a columnist falls in love with his schoolmate when they meet after years. Just as he decides to win her heart, he learns that she is engaged to another man.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Cheesy enlists Theodore and Alvin to steal desserts from the school kitchen in 'The Underground', then in 'Game House', Simon invents a virtual reality game that quickly gets out of hand. (S5, ep 25)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin tells Theodore that he can turn rubbish into sweets in 'Alvin's Secret Powers', then in 'Warbie', The Chipmunks find a baby bird that's fallen from its nest. (S1, ep 24)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany give wildly differing versions of why the fire alarm went off in 'He Said She Said', then in 'Attack of the Zombies', Alvin and Theodore try to protect their loved ones. (S2, ep 23)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore must prove he's got the right stuff in 'Lost in Space...Camp', then in 'Super Hot Chocolate', Theodore loses his sense of taste. (S3, ep 23)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave gets bad reviews on the internet in 'You Troll', then in 'Life of the Party', The Chipmunks along with Kevin and Cheesy decide to crash BoCarter's party after not being invited. (S4, ep 22)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany wind up in a battle royale in 'Bubble Wrap', and in 'Chess Mate', a cute girl joins the chess club, so Alvin enlists Jeanette to teach him to play so he can join too. (S5, ep 21)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette is proclaimed a fashion trendsetter by Brittany's icon in 'She's Got Style', then in 'Super Heroes', Theodore thinks he's a real superhero, and Alvin and Simon can't convince him. (S1, ep 19)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: A new boy band tries to steal the spotlight in 'We're the Chipmunks', then in 'Save the Dance', the Principal gives Alvin & Derek an ultimatum - if they fight, the dance will be cancelled. (S2, ep 17)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: To Serve And Protect: Simon is ecstatic when he's elected as the school's safety monitor. But when Alvin goofs off at school, Simon faces a moral dilemma. (S1, ep 13)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Pirates Life: When pirates show up at the house, the boys do all they can to protect a treasure chest that arrived for Dave. (S4, ep 6a)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Gossip Guy: The school newspaper has a sudden increase in sales when a gossip column appears poking fun at other students. (S4, ep 18b)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Double Trouble: Alvin sneaks into Simon's lab to look at his latest invention, only to accidentally clone himself. With two Alvins, there's bound to be double the trouble.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin goes all out to make a new friend in 'Talking Teddy's Revenge', then in 'Snail-A-Palooza', Alvin lies to Theodore about a fake holiday to get out of chores, but things soon get real. (S3, ep 16)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Coach Dobkins kicks Cheesy and Theodore off the track team in 'Between a Rope and A Hard Place', then in 'World Day', The Chipmunks each get represent a country for a school presentation. (S4, ep 15)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin takes Simon's place on a camping trip in 'Excavation Vacation', and in 'Trophy Dad', The Chipmunks suspect Dave is lying about the various awards he's won. (S5, ep 14)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin is convinced his mojo was in a cap he gave away in 'Mojo Missing', then in 'Who's The Animal', Alvin finds himself mistaken for a Tasmanian devil during a costume visit to the zoo. (S1, ep 12)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin accidentally clones himself in 'Double Trouble', then in 'Liar Liar', Alvin tells a small lie that quickly turns into a huge disaster, dragging everyone into his tangled web. (S2, ep 10)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin regrets pranking Simon after facing payback in 'Curiosity Killed The Alvin', then in 'House Pest', Miss Croner moves in and annoys the chipmunks. (S3, ep 9)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin accuses Dave of yelling at him too much in 'Alvin Management', then in 'Time Capsule', the school digs up an old high school time capsule, and Miss Smith and Dave keep an old secret. (S4, ep 8)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin finally pushes Miss Smith too far, she quits in 'Missing Miss Smith', then in 'Monster Madness', Alvin and Simon tease The Chipettes about being scared by a movie. (S2, ep 14)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin suspects his neighbour is responsible for a recent heist in 'What A Gem', and in 'Family Spirit', Alvin tries to get out of the family picnic with Dave to go to a soccer game. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin begs Dave to spend a weekend alone with him in 'Alvin's Wild Weekend', then in 'For Whom the Bell Tolls', a hypnotist accidentally turns Simon into a bumbling fool! (S2, ep 8)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The boys build a treehouse in the backyard and move out in 'Independence Day', and in 'Opposites Attract', an invention of Simon's accidently magnetizes Alvin and Simon to each other. (S3, ep 11)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin kidnaps Simon's robot Geizmo in 'Geizmo's Day Out', then in 'Unbored', when Dave takes away Alvin's phone, the boredom Alvin experiences is enough to drive him crazy. (S4, ep 25)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore is training for a TV baking competition with Eleanor in 'Allergic Reaction', then in 'Lice-enced to Teach', Dave sets up a classroom in the house, and becomes the teacher. (S4, ep 16)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipmunks take in a stray dog, but must keep the puppy hidden from Dave in 'Dog Days', then in 'Dragon Dad', Theodore orders a dragon egg in the hopes of it hatching into a real dragon. (S2, ep 1)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Derek plans a wild party at Alvin's house in 'Animal House Party', then in 'Dr. Zap vs Electroboy', Theodore is hit by lightning and believes he's like his comic book hero. (S4, ep 17)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave discovers he didn't graduate from high school and ends up in class with Alvin in 'Back to School', then in 'Bromance', Simon has found a new best friend, but then gets ditched. (S1, ep 16)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin makes fun of Simon's magic act, Simon challenges him to a magic duel in 'Simon the Superb', then in 'The Sub', Alvin reluctantly signs up to teach the after school music class. (S2, ep 3)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipmunks get stuck in traffic in 'Car Wars', then in 'Mr. Fix-It', Simon gets annoyed with everyone asking him to fix things so he decides to play dumb until he gets some thanks. (S5, ep 17)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon moves into a tree for some alone time in 'Back To Basics', then in 'Report Cards', Alvin worries about his bad report card and does everything to catch the mail before Dave sees it. (S3, ep 2)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave refuses to let Alvin get a dangerous toy sports car in 'Safety Third', then in 'Mister Manners', Alvin must pass a manners course before he gets his dream meeting with a Princess. (S1, ep 14)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany dreams of being a fashion designer in 'The Devil Wears Rodentia', then in 'Career Day', Alvin suspects Dave of being a local bank robber when Dave starts acting suspiciously. (S3, ep 22)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette is proclaimed a fashion trendsetter by Brittany's icon in 'She's Got Style', then in 'Super Heroes', Theodore thinks he's a real superhero, and Alvin and Simon can't convince him. (S1, ep 19)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore struggles to do good deeds in 'Knights', and then in 'Snake Charmer', Alvin and Simon create a fake snake to help Dave get over his fear of snakes. (S2, ep 19)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore helps Simon to try and get past his perfectionism in 'Artsy Smartsy', then in 'The Crush', Simon has a crush on the babysitter and secretly prepares a romantic dinner. (S4, ep 13)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Roy Ward Baker. Stars: Robert Ryan, Rhonda Fleming & William Lundigan. A tough business man is left to die with broken leg in the desert by his scheming wife and her lover.

programme.title: Flic Story
programme.desc: 1975. Drama. Director: Jacques Deray. Stars Alain Delon, Jean-Louis Trintignant & Renato Salvatori. The hunt for a seasoned killer becomes a matter of life for a policeman.

programme.title: Prisoners of the Tower
programme.desc: 1946. Documentary. Directed by Cecil H. Williamson. Narrated by Valentine Dyall. A newly discovered film covering the fascinating story of The Tower of London.

programme.title: The Lawless Years
programme.desc: The Dutch Schultz Story. 1959. Stars James Gregory, John Dennis & Ken Lynch. A Dutchman plots a hit on Dewey after he describes the gangster as an 'evil force that has to be destroyed.'

programme.title: False Colours
programme.desc: 1943. Western. Director: George Archainbaud. Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his sidekicks (Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers) expose a scheme to replace a ranch heir with an impostor.

programme.title: The Veil
programme.desc: Jack the Ripper. 1958. Stars Boris Karloff, Niall MacGinnis & Dorothy Alison. A troubled clairvoyant dreams of Jack the Ripper's killings and assists the police.

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Children's Day Affair. 1965. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Jeanne Cooper. An U.N.C.L.E. security conference is threatened when it emerges that a nearby school is a front for THRUSH.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Split Ticket. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. When O'Casey wins the lottery, they must find Albert before the ticket runs out.

programme.title: The Gilded Cage
programme.desc: 1955. Directed by John Gilling and starring Alex Nicol. Two brothers are embroiled in a racket to smuggle a valuable painting. When a murder is committed they must try and clear their names.

programme.title: Those People Next Door
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Directed by John Harlow and starring Jack Warner, Charles Victor, Jimmy James & Anthony Newley. A young man's titled parents object to his working-class fiance.

programme.title: David Bailey: Four Beats to the Bar and no Cheating
programme.desc: 2010. Jerome De Missolz. David Bailey, a cultural icon who has been at the cutting edge of contemporary art for 50 years.

programme.title: Penny Serenade
programme.desc: 1941. Drama. Director: George Stevens. Stars Irene Dunne, Cary Grant, Beulah Bondi & Edgar Buchanan. A couple's big dreams give way to a life full of unexpected sadness and unexpected joy.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: Castle of Fear. 1959. Stars Conrad Phillips, Ferdy Mayne & Edwin Richfield. William visits Werner Castle to track down a murderer but receives a warning of death, with his own life at risk.

programme.title: The Stranger Came Home
programme.desc: 1954. Mystery. Directed by Terence Fisher. Stars Paulette Goddard & William Sylvester. A man returns home after being missing for three years to find those responsible for the attempt on his life.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout October.

programme.title: Nobody Runs Forever
programme.desc: 1968. Action. Director: Ralph Thomas. Stars Christopher Plummer, Rod Taylor & Lilli Palmer. An Australian detective arrives in London to arrest a top diplomat for the murder of his first wife.

programme.title: Son of a Stranger
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Directed by Ernest Morris. Stars James Kenney, Ann Stephens & Victor Maddern. A young man searches for the father he never knew, with the belief that he is a rich aristocrat.

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Adriatic Express Affair. 1965. Stars Robert Vaughn & Jessie Royce Landis. Solo and Kuryakin ride the Adriatic Express to Venice, seeking a THRUSH virus that could wipe out the human race.

programme.title: Buccaneer
programme.desc: Emergency. 1980. Stars Bryan Marshall, Clifford Rose & Pamela Salem. Burton has persuaded Anglo Oil to overload the Britannia. Kim ponders her future and Janet's ex-husband wants to remarry.

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's A Man Called Harry Brent
programme.desc: The Flowers. 1965. Stars Edward Brayshaw, Gerald Harper & Jennifer Daniel. Tom loses his secretary and needs a replacement, Barbara is one he should have avoided.

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's A Man Called Harry Brent
programme.desc: Jacqueline. 1965. Stars Edward Brayshaw, Gerald Harper & Jennifer Daniel. An old acquaintance recounts how she overheard Tom discussing his death with Harry Brent.

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's A Man Called Harry Brent
programme.desc: The Pen. 1965. Stars Edward Brayshaw, Gerald Harper & Jennifer Daniel. Mrs Tolly's husband puts a devious plan in action to obtain Mr Fielding's fountain pen.

programme.title: Payday
programme.desc: 1973. Director: Daryl Duke. Stars Rip Torn, Ahna Capri & Elayne Heilveil. Maury Dann, a not-so-nice country-western singer, ruthlessly manipulates everyone around him to suit his selfish needs.

programme.title: There is Another Sun
programme.desc: Directed by Lewis Gilbert. Laurence Harvey is 'Mag Maguire' a fairground boxer and Maxwell Reed, 'Eddie Racer' a motorbike daredevil rider. The mutual love interest is the lovely Susan Shaw.

programme.title: Bullet Scars
programme.desc: 1942. Crime Drama. Directed by D. Ross Lederman. Stars Regis Toomey, Adele Longmire & Howard Da Silva. A doctor and a nurse are forced to treat a wounded gangster who was injured during a robbery.

programme.title: Look At Life Submarine
programme.desc: 1960. A look at life in a submarine and the work that is carried out within.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: Federico Fellini was an Italian film director and screenwriter. Known for his distinct style he is recognized as one of the greatest and most influential filmmakers of all time.

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Adriatic Express Affair. 1965. Stars Robert Vaughn & Jessie Royce Landis. Solo and Kuryakin ride the Adriatic Express to Venice, seeking a THRUSH virus that could wipe out the human race.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the French Interpreter. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. When an interpreter says he was kidnapped, Sherlock investigates further.

programme.title: Sons Of The Sea
programme.desc: 1939. Drama. The Head of Dartmouth training college is murdered but was he the intended victim? Directed by Maurice Elvey. Starring Leslie Banks and Kay Walsh.

programme.title: Paul Temple's Triumph
programme.desc: 1950. Nettlefold Films production directed by Maclean Rogers and starring John Bentley & Dinah Sheridan. Paul Temple is on the hunt for a kidnapped scientist who's invented a secret formula.

programme.title: The Treasure of San Teresa
programme.desc: 1959. War. Director: Alvin Rakoff. Stars Eddie Constantine, Dawn Addams, Marius Goring, Christopher Lee. Ex-serviceman, Larry, returns to Europe to retrieve jewels hidden from the Nazis in 1944.

programme.title: Tarnished Heroes
programme.desc: 1961. War. Directed by Ernest Morris. Stars Dermot Walsh & Patrick McAlinney. Major Bell and a ragtag team undertake a dangerous mission to destroy a bridge of strategic importance to the enemy.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Spy Aboard. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Richard Johnson & Danny Green. Tempest is robbed by the ruthless pirate Peg Leg and comes to the realisation that there is a spy aboard the Sultana.

programme.title: Hindle Wakes
programme.desc: 1952. Drama starring Leslie Dwyer and Lisa Daniely. Successful remake of one of the earliest British talkies. Set in the Hindle, two mill workers take off to Blackpool for the 'Wakes' holiday.

programme.title: Look At Life Chicken In The Mill
programme.desc: 1961. A look into the new industrial revolution in Lancashire; from 1950, more than 55 cotton mills were converted for light industries. This film examines the change for Lancashire's workers.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Ghost Squad. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Russell Napier & Douglas Wilmer. Maguire is sent to the London docks as a part of the 'Ghost Squad' to investigate a number of thieves operating there.

programme.title: Obsession
programme.desc: 1949. Thriller. Director: Edward Dmytryk. Stars: Robert Newton, Sally Gray & Phil Brown. A cuckolded psychiatrist kidnaps his wife's lover and hides him away while he plans his revenge.

programme.title: Rooms
programme.desc: Mr Cotgrove & Miss Hicks P1. Michael Gwynn, Annette Crosbie & Jane Wenham. Mr Cotgrove lives very much alone on the first floor. He's 50 and a teacher at a comprehensive.

programme.title: Rooms
programme.desc: Mr Cotgrove & Miss Hicks P2. Michael Gwynn, Annette Crosbie & Jane Wenham. Over dinner, Mr Cotgrove tells Miss Hicks why he is living in a bedsitter in Barons Court.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: British Finches/Yerro's Operation. 1986. Jack sees almost every member of the British finch family in a country garden before recounting the story of his noisy mule, Yerro.

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: The Pursuit. 1979. Stars Richard O'Sullivan, Michael Deeks & Stacy Dorning. After being robbed, Dick and Swiftnick pursue a masked highwayman down a trail leading towards a country house.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: A Man of No Importance. Stars Barry Foster, Michael Latimer & Susan Travers. When a dead man turns up on the deck of a canal barge, everyone is ready to dismiss him as a nonentity.

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's A Man Called Harry Brent
programme.desc: The Problem. 1965. Stars Edward Brayshaw, Gerald Harper & Jennifer Daniel. Alan shares the discovered films with Carol, a discussion forces him to confide in her.

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's...
programme.desc: ...A Man Called Harry Brrent. Tolly Changes His Mind. 1965. Stars Edward Brayshaw, Gerald Harper & Jennifer Daniel. Carol disappears after Harry explains what's going on, Tolly confesses to a lie.

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's A Man Called Harry Brent
programme.desc: The Third Person. 1965. Stars Edward Brayshaw, Gerald Harper & Jennifer Daniel. Alan enlists the help of Carol to set a trap for the killer.

programme.title: The Cassandra Crossing
programme.desc: 1976. Drama. Director: George P Cosmatos. Stars Sophia Loren, Richard Harris, Burt Lancaster & Martin Sheen. Passengers of a European train can't escape after a deadly virus is planted.

programme.title: Dick Tracy Returns
programme.desc: 1938. Actions. Directors John English & William Witney. Stars Ralph Byrd, Lynn Roberts & Charles Middleton. Tracy battles spies and saboteurs in his efforts to bring to justice the Stark gang.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1957. Bullet from the Past. Director: Kenneth Hume. Stars Ballard Berkeley, Robert Sansom and Philippa Hyatt. An inspector investigates the shooting of a man connected to an old cold case. (S1, E20)

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: Blind Man's Bluff. Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray run a stagecoach line in the Old West, where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Hi Diddle Riddle. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Neil Hamilton. The Riddler's twisted trail leads Batman to break the law and fall before the criminal charms of a beautiful Molehill Mob moll.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Smack in the Middle. 1966. Stars Adam West, Frank Gorshin & Jill St. John. The Riddler holds Robin hostage to lure Batman into a trap that could mean the end of the Caped Crusader.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Singing Violin. 1954. Stars Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. Betty is being tormented by apparent hallucinations, so her fiancé calls Sherlock and Dr Watson.

programme.title: The Voice Of Merrill
programme.desc: 1952. Crime Drama. Directed by John Gilling. Starring Valerie Hobson, James Robertson Justice & Sam Kydd. A dying author frames a radio narrator for killing his secretary.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout October.

programme.title: No Trace

programme.title: The Crooked Sky
programme.desc: 1957. Crime drama directed by Henry Cass. An American detective & Scotland Yard must work together to crack a counterfeit gang. Stars Wayne Morris, Karin Booth and Anton Diffring.

programme.title: The Spider and the Fly
programme.desc: 1949. Crime. Directed by Robert Hamer. Stars Eric Portman, Nadia Gray & George Cole. An unusual love triangle develops between two criminals and a policeman on the eve of the first World War.

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
programme.desc: Trouble and Strife. 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, John Cater & Maureen O'Brien. A woman from Starr's past, down on her luck, begs him to use his influence to obtain a job for her at the Bentinck.

programme.title: High Tide
programme.desc: 1980. Thriller. A man just released from prison for manslaughter heads to the West Country to solve the mystery behind his victim's cryptic last words. Stars Ian McShane, Wendy Morgan & John Bird.

programme.title: Look At Life Any Old Iron
